description:
NVIDIA is searching for a highly motivated, creative engineer with experience in system software and a background in security to join the Server Platform Software team. You will focus on offensive security efforts for our Data Center Systems, such as NVIDIA HGX, DGX, and MGX. NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Find vulnerabilities and write exploits against Data Center Systems firmware. Targets include management controllers, roots of trust, BIOS, GPUs, SmartNICs, and NVLink switches.
  • Work from the platform's threat models: tenants attacking the management plane, operators attacking confidential workloads, and tampering in the supply chain
  • Get people excited about security: influence change, mitigate issue classes, and enhance defense in depth
  • Automate finding bugs, judging their severity, and mapping them to platform-level threats

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years in security engineering or vulnerability research, including 4+ years of software engineering
  • Exceptional C and Python skills, and fluency reading ARM or RISC-V assembly
  • Experience auditing embedded firmware, Linux applications, and network-facing services
  • Experience with modern fuzzers such as AFL++, libFuzzer, or syzkaller, and with static analysis
  • Knowledge of modern server architecture and secure boot
  • Clear written and verbal communication with engineering teams and leadership
  • Effective collaboration with remote teams

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Reverse engineering and exploit development experience on embedded targets
  • Experience attacking or building trusted computing: measured boot, attestation, confidential computing
  • Familiarity with GPU-accelerated computing systems and their management planes
  • Experience decomposing and completing complex technical tasks
  • Published CVEs, public security write-ups, or other work samples

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people on the planet working for us. If you're creative, passionate and self-motivated, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
152,000 USD – 241,500 USD for Level 3; and 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 16, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy. 

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
